subject: English
question_text: Complete the following passage using suitable connectors:
stimulus: ⎯⎯ None can deny the importance of tree plantation (a) our lives on earth inevitably depend on it. (b) ⎯⎯ it is a matter of sorrow that we are cutting down trees indiscriminately. (c) ⎯⎯ trees are planted, soon our country will turn into desert. (d) ⎯⎯ there will be an adverse change in the climate. (e) ⎯⎯ we should plant more and more trees for our own sake.
source: SSC English 2nd-paper Cumilla Board-2020 (Board Question With Solution)
